findings.summary: Formatting-mark/hidden-text toggle could panic the debug GUI in tiny-skia hairline_aa
findings.detail: Toggling a view option during document editing reached joyword_render::rasterize with a 1-2 px wide rect at a fractional x offset. tiny-skia 0.11.4 asserted in scan/hairline_aa.rs:124. The rasterizer now snaps sub-2-pixel rect widths to whole device pixels, preserving at least one pixel and the subpixel-underline behavior. Regression narrow_fractional_rects_keep_their_pixels_without_panicking covers vertical and horizontal cases.

findings.summary: Fcitx/Sogou input does not reach the GPUI X11 window
findings.detail: The desktop IME was active and Fcitx reported state 2, but nihao was inserted literally and no candidate window appeared. This matches the earlier Kylin result and leaves Chinese typing through a system IME unverified on Xinchuang desktop systems.

findings.summary: X11 file chooser is absent without the portal service
findings.detail: Ctrl+O produced no chooser and Ctrl+S/Ctrl+Shift+S produced no save dialog. The app remained usable, but GUI open/save/export and the hundred-page GUI acceptance remain blocked on this host.

findings.summary: Kernel 4.19 jiffy timestamps make two identity tests flaky
findings.detail: A same-length rewrite and a hard-link alias write within one timer tick are not distinguished by mtime/ctime. The guard is documented as a known limitation; this is not counted as a passing conflict check.

findings.summary: Plain startup failed because no adapter could configure the display surface
findings.detail: Without VK_ICD_FILENAMES the Vulkan loader found no physical device and the GL backend only enumerated llvmpipe with no compatible surface formats. The app now preflights for a render node when no ICD is explicit, finds a software ICD and re-execs itself with VK_ICD_FILENAMES/VK_DRIVER_FILES; a failed open_window also retries the same way. Explicit ICDs are never overridden. Regression a_software_vulkan_icd_is_found_by_name covers the name search; the plain run now selects SwiftShader Vulkan and opens the window. A fake renderD file forced the post-failure path and the app log recorded window.software_retry kind=vulkan before restarting.
